stories.title: Referendum Planned on New Provinces in Pakistan, Says Mustafa Kamal
stories.summary:
Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan leader Mustafa Kamal announced that a referendum will be conducted regarding the establishment of new provinces, highlighting December as a critical timeframe for the initiative. Speaking to party members in Karachi’s District Central, Kamal stated that Pakistan is at a crucial turning point in history and claimed that adversaries of the proposed administrative changes aim to divide linguistic communities. He also asserted that the Pakistan Peoples Party does not speak for all of Sindh and criticized Sindhi nationalists.

Simultaneously, government officials revealed that preparations are finalized to grant Islamabad a special administrative status under a revised governance structure. The proposal could establish the capital as a special-status territory featuring a mayor as its administrative head alongside an elected body of 25 to 30 members. Plans also involve enlarging Islamabad's geographic limits by potentially absorbing parts of Haripur district, portions of Rawalpindi, and areas of NA-51 in Murree, while an initial idea to include Gwadar has been discarded.

The discussion follows statements from Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who called a public vote the ideal approach to resolving the matter while emphasizing the need to involve political parties like the PPP and PML-N. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif likewise supported forming new provinces based on administrative needs, noting that up to 12 could be evaluated. While broader restructuring concepts suggest dividing Punjab into four provinces, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan into three each, and Sindh into two, no formal decisions regarding boundaries or constitutional procedures have been finalized.

stories.title: Federal Investigation Agency Files Charges Against Eight Deportees from Turkey
stories.summary:
The Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) Immigration in Islamabad has filed a formal complaint against eight Pakistani citizens following their deportation from Turkey. According to an official statement, the individuals originally traveled to Turkey on valid work visas but allegedly violated visa regulations by taking employment at unauthorized locations instead of their approved companies.

Preliminary investigations indicate that Turkish authorities detained the group, placed them in jail, and subsequently arranged for their deportation back to Pakistan. Following their return, the FIA registered a case against the eight citizens under Sections 3 and 4 of the Passport Act of 1974.

Authorities are continuing their inquiries to determine if any other individuals, local agents, or facilitators were involved in orchestrating the visa violations. This ongoing investigation aims to uncover any wider networks that might be facilitating unauthorized employment abroad for Pakistani nationals.

The case highlights the strict enforcement of visa compliance by foreign nations and the subsequent legal scrutiny deportees face upon returning to Pakistan. The FIA's actions underline the government's commitment to investigating potential immigration offenses and related illicit activities.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Districts Impose Section 144 to Ban Public Gatherings
stories.summary:
District administrations across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa have implemented Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, enforcing a 30-day ban on public gatherings and various related activities. The restrictions affect the districts of Bajaur, Lakki Marwat, Swabi, and Tank amid ongoing security concerns and challenging law and order conditions in the region.

In Bajaur, Deputy Commissioner Adnan Farid Afridi approved the measures to prohibit political gatherings, hate speech against the state, and the display of weapons. The administration in Swabi, led by Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Khan, banned rallies, processions, and demonstrations to protect public safety. Similarly, Lakki Marwat's Deputy Commissioner Shahid Rafique restricted assemblies, weapons possession, pillion riding, and the placement of temporary structures on roadways. Tank's Deputy Commissioner Jamshed Khan also announced bans on processions, rallies, pillion riding, and the public display of weapons.

These preventive orders are designed to prevent potential security threats, protect human lives and property, and maintain public peace. Law enforcement agencies have been instructed to heighten vigilance, enhance security at entry and exit points, and strictly monitor unauthorized public movements.

The bans will remain active for a month, with specific end dates in mid-December depending on the district notification dates. Authorities have warned that any violations of these orders will be met with stern legal action under Section 188 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

stories.title: Wasim Akram Weighs in on Australia's 2018 Ball-Tampering Scandal Controversy
stories.summary:
Former Pakistan cricket captain Wasim Akram has commented on the 2018 Australian ball-tampering scandal, stating that experienced bowlers would instantly recognize if a cricket ball had been altered using sandpaper. Speaking in a social media video, Akram explained that while bowlers occasionally create minor scratches using the pitch, sandpaper marks are entirely distinct and easily identifiable by anyone familiar with the game.

Akram clarified that his remarks represented his personal perspective rather than taking sides, while also praising Australians for their overall honesty. His comments drew a sharp reaction from English broadcaster Piers Morgan, who asserted on social media that the former fast bowler was politely implying that the Australian bowlers were aware of the tampering and should tell the truth.

The controversy stems from the March 2018 Test match in Cape Town, where television cameras caught Cameron Bancroft using sandpaper on the ball. Cricket Australia subsequently banned Bancroft, Steve Smith, and David Warner. The scandal recently resurfaced due to claims in Usman Khawaja's 2026 autobiography alleging broader team knowledge, a stance supported by David Warner and former bowler Chadd Sayers, though captain Pat Cummins rejected the allegations as nonsense and Cricket Australia ruled out reopening the investigation.

stories.title: Pakistan to Host 30th ECO Council of Ministers Meeting in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Pakistan is set to host the 30th Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO) Council of Ministers in Islamabad. The gathering will convene foreign ministers and senior representatives from member states, alongside various regional and international organizations, as Pakistan steps into its role as the incoming ECO Chair for 2026-27.

The meeting's agenda focuses on enhancing regional cooperation across trade, transport, investment, and sustainable development. Attendees are expected to adopt the Islamabad Declaration and approve ECO Vision 2035, a ten-year strategic framework designed to improve economic integration and regional connectivity. Furthermore, Pakistan plans to advocate for advancements on the ECO Trade Agreement and the Transit Transport Framework Agreement to streamline cross-border commerce.

This conference highlights Pakistan's strategic position as a regional hub, bolstered by initiatives like the proposed Uzbekistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan railway project. It builds upon bilateral trade agreements with Central Asian nations and Azerbaijan to strengthen supply chains and transit arrangements.

Serving as a founding ECO member, Pakistan currently houses several organization institutions and holds the ECO Secretary General’s office through Ambassador Asad Majeed Khan until 2027. Officials view the ministerial event as a vital platform to elevate Pakistan's diplomatic standing and foster deeper regional economic partnerships ahead of upcoming international summits.

stories.title: Gulf Stock Markets Decline Amid Strait of Hormuz Disruptions and Houthi Attacks
stories.summary:
Most stock markets across the Gulf closed lower on Sunday as traders evaluated mounting regional conflicts, including maritime disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and ongoing Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia. Iranian state media confirmed that a mine strike in the strategic strait set three oil tankers ablaze on Saturday. Consequently, Saudi Arabia’s benchmark index dropped 0.7 percent to settle at 10,258, with the nation's largest lender by assets, Saudi National Bank, falling 2.3 percent. Additionally, the Saudi-led coalition countering the Houthis reported intercepting two ballistic missiles over Riyadh and three drones directed at the kingdom's Eastern Province.

In response to intensifying Houthi strikes on airports, seaports, and energy infrastructure, Riyadh has expanded its air campaign against targets in Yemen. Meanwhile, the Qatari index retreated 1.8 percent to 9,848, with all of its constituents entering negative territory, including the Gulf's largest lender, Qatar National Bank, which dropped 2.3 percent. Qatar's liquefied natural gas exports have suffered severely due to the ongoing conflict with Iran, forcing the nation to declare force majeure on deliveries after a March attack. This led to the cancellation of a long-standing Gulf LNG contract for the first time since the conflict began, a move analysts estimate could save Poland’s Orlen up to $2 billion.

Amid these escalating regional tensions, Turkey and Qatar signed a mutual defense pact on Friday to enhance joint security. Following leadership talks, the two nations issued a joint statement pledging a united front against any foreign armed attack on either country. Outside the Gulf region, performance varied, with Egypt’s blue-chip index inching up 0.3 percent to 52,187. Losses were also recorded elsewhere in the region, as Bahrain fell 0.4 percent to 1,821, Oman eased 0.1 percent to 7,347, and Kuwait traded down 0.3 percent to 8,991.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto and Fazal ur Rehman Discuss Pakistan's Political Crisis by Phone
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari and Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam chief Maulana Fazal ur Rehman held a telephone conversation to discuss the prevailing political situation in the country. Maulana Fazlur Rehman initiated the contact to exchange views on current political developments, prompting strong criticism from Bilawal regarding recent government actions directed against the JUI-F.

During the discussion, Bilawal asserted that the government must learn to tolerate opposition criticism, emphasizing that a responsible opposition is vital for a healthy democracy and parliamentary system. He cautioned against any actions that could potentially weaken parliament and democratic norms. His remarks follow a series of legal and investigatory pressures facing the JUI-F leadership and its associates.

Recently, a terrorism case was filed against Mufti Abrar Ahmed, who serves as the secretary to the JUI-F chief, alongside more than 200 unidentified party workers. According to a party spokesperson, the charges include allegations of assaulting police personnel, which the party has dismissed as false accusations. The JUI-F maintained that utilizing criminal charges and state power to address political differences directly undermines democratic values.

In a separate development, the National Accountability Bureau issued another call-up notice to Asad Mahmood, the son of the JUI-F chief, regarding an ongoing inquiry into alleged illegal appointments within the Pakistan Post Office Department. Meanwhile, in Islamabad, immigration authorities filed a complaint against eight Pakistani citizens who were deported from Turkey after allegedly violating the terms of their work visas by working at unapproved locations.

stories.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet Allowing AI Agents to Make Purchases
stories.summary:
OpenAI has introduced a new feature called ChatGPT Wallet that enables its AI agents, known as dots, to independently book hotels and buy products online. Developed in collaboration with major payment networks American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the tool is currently rolling out gradually to Pro subscribers aged 18 or older residing in the United States with a US billing address.

To use the feature, users securely store a credit card once, as debit cards are not supported. When an agent prepares a transaction, it displays the merchant, items, total cost, and selected card. The user must then approve the purchase using Face ID, Touch ID, or a fingerprint. Following approval, the card network generates a substitute payment token, ensuring that neither the merchant nor the agent ever gains access to the actual card number.

While the system protects user data and maintains standard card rewards and dispute protections, approval does not automatically complete the order. A "Ready to check out" status only confirms user approval, meaning final confirmation depends on the merchant, and duplicate orders can occur if a user mistakenly buys again. Furthermore, subscriptions may lead to recurring charges that require cancellation directly through the merchant, and removing a card from the wallet only stops future agent payments.

This development comes as many websites and banks actively block AI agents from making purchases. OpenAI has provided merchants with a guide on how to adjust fraud filters and accept signed agent requests. Future updates are expected to allow users to establish spending limits, time frames, or categories and pre-approve transactions so they will not need to manually authorize each individual purchase.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari Condemns Government Actions Against JUI-F Chief Fazl
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari held a telephone conversation with Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman to condemn what he described as government actions and political vengeance directed against the religious party. The call took place amid ongoing tensions between the JUI-F leadership and the federal government led by the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N).

During their discussion, the two leaders reviewed the current political situation in Pakistan. Bilawal, whose party belongs to the ruling coalition, stated that the government must tolerate opposition criticism and avoid actions that undermine Parliament and weaken democracy. The conversation coincided with street protests held by JUI-F in several cities across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to protest against alleged propaganda targeting the party and its leadership.

Bilawal has recently advocated for a political reset and urged the prime minister to foster trust with both political allies and the opposition. The exchange highlights ongoing friction within the political landscape as lawmakers navigate parliamentary dynamics, institutional relations, and public demonstrations by opposition factions.

stories.title: HEC Urges Students to Verify Private University Accreditation Before Enrolling
stories.summary:
The Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan has issued an advisory urging students seeking admission to private educational institutions to verify the accreditation status of their chosen schools on the official HEC website prior to applying. The guidance aims to prevent students from enrolling in unrecognized programs and wasting financial resources on unaccredited degrees.

The HEC portal provides an exhaustive directory of recognized universities alongside their approved campuses, as well as a list of approved Transnational Education (TNE) programs that allow students to pursue foreign degrees locally. Additionally, the higher education authority has published a roster of fake and illegal institutions operating throughout the country. To streamline the verification process, the HEC has implemented scannable QR codes that grant direct access to information regarding recognized universities, TNE options, and fraudulent institutions.

stories.title: ASEAN and China Fail to Finalize South China Sea Code
stories.summary:
Members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and China failed to conclude a long-delayed Code of Conduct in the South China Sea during the bloc's summit in Manila. Philippine Foreign Minister Ma. Theresa Lazaro stated that negotiations could not be finished under the Philippines' chairmanship, despite a provisional agreement being reached on roughly 80 percent of the draft text.

Talks regarding the code have persisted for more than two decades. Key obstacles include unresolved debates over whether the agreement will be legally binding, alongside differing viewpoints between Beijing and Southeast Asian neighbors. ASEAN nations insist that the code must align with international law, whereas China maintains that its maritime actions are lawful. Beijing claims nearly the entirety of the South China Sea, overlapping with the exclusive economic zones of Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam, and rejects a 2016 international tribunal ruling that invalidated its sweeping claims.

Analysts note that deadlocks stem not only from tensions between ASEAN and China, but also from internal divisions among ASEAN members regarding the geographical scope of the code. Singapore is set to take over the chairmanship next year and will inherit the responsibility of trying to bridge remaining differences, which experts say will demand major concessions from all participating sides.

stories.title: Lalit Modi Obtains British Citizenship After 16 Years Away From India
stories.summary:
Lalit Modi, the founder and former chairman of the Indian Premier League (IPL), has officially acquired British citizenship 16 years after departing from India. The disclosure was made by Modi himself during a speech delivered at the Oxford Union on November 14, where he announced that his formal transition to a British citizen took place on September 15, 2026. 

During his address, Modi described securing British citizenship as a significant and proud milestone in his life. He noted that he has resided in the United Kingdom for an extended period and expressed deep respect for the country's people, institutions, customs, and values. Furthermore, he characterized holding UK citizenship as both a great honor and a major responsibility, stating his intention to keep making positive contributions to the nation moving forward. 

Modi originally relocated to the UK back in 2010 amid an ongoing government inquiry concerning alleged financial irregularities linked to the IPL. He has remained based in Britain ever since that initial move over a decade ago. 

Separately, technological updates noted that OpenAI has introduced new capabilities allowing AI agents to make online payments independently. Utilizing the ChatGPT Wallet feature tied to cloud-computer agents launched in late September, users can buy items and book hotels through partnerships with major financial networks including American Express, Mastercard, and Visa.

stories.title: Pakistani and Saudi leaders top the 2027 influential Muslims list
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces and Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir have tied for the top position on the 2027 edition of 'The Muslim 500: The World's 500 Most Influential Muslims' list. They share the highest rank alongside Saudi King Salman, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

Compiled annually by the Amman-based Royal Islamic Strategic Studies Centre, this marks the first time multiple individuals have shared the top spot. The publication attributed this historic decision to the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, signed on August 7, 2026, and activated during an emergency summit in Riyadh. The mutual-defence pact unites Saudi wealth, Turkish manufacturing and technology, and Pakistan's military strength under a collective alliance modeled on a 'one for all, all for one' security approach.

Further down the rankings, Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei is placed fourth, Jordan's King Abdullah II fifth, and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani sixth. Pakistani religious scholar Sheikh Muhammad Taqi Usmani is ranked seventh, while UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan holds the 12th position and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi sits at 22nd.

The list also includes other notable figures such as Pakistani religious scholar Maulana Tariq Jameel at 32nd, footballer Mohamed Salah at 39th, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas at 45th, and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani at 49th. Additionally, the report noted Pakistan's recent efforts in navigating economic stabilization, regional security pressures, and diplomatic balancing.

stories.title: کولمبیا کے سابق صدر گستاوو پیٹرو مبینہ سیکس اسکینڈل کی زد میں
stories.summary:
کولمبیا کے سابق صدر گستاوو پیٹرو ایک سنگین سیاسی تنازعے کی لپیٹ میں آ گئے ہیں۔ یہ ہلچل 25 اکتوبر کو اس وقت شروع ہوئی جب ڈیسی خیمنیز نامی ایک خاتون نے صحافی وکی ڈیویلا کو ایک طویل انٹرویو دیا۔ خاتون نے دعویٰ کیا کہ صدر بننے سے پہلے اور مدتِ صدارت کے دوران ان کے سابق صدر کے ساتھ رومانوی تعلقات رہے، اور اسی بنیاد پر انھیں سرکاری اداروں میں ملازمتیں اور ٹھیکے ملے تھے۔ خیمنیز کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ تقریباً تیس سے چالیس خواتین پر مشتمل ایک نیٹ ورک اس قسم کے فوائد حاصل کرتا رہا ہے۔

اس انٹرویو کے سامنے آنے کے بعد کولمبیا کے میڈیا میں اس معاملے کو ’سیکس کنٹریکٹس‘ کا نام دیا گیا ہے اور مختلف عدالتی فورمز پر تحقیقات کا آغاز بھی کر دیا گیا ہے۔ الیکٹرانک پبلک پروکیورمنٹ سسٹم کے ریکارڈ کے مطابق ڈیسی خیمنیز کے تین مختلف سرکاری اداروں کے ساتھ 2021 سے 2026 کے درمیان دس معاہدے درج ہیں، جن کی مجموعی مالیت بارہ کروڑ پینسٹھ لاکھ چوالیس ہزار کولمبین پیسو سے زائد بنتی ہے۔

سابق صدر گستاوو پیٹرو نے جنسی تعلقات کے بدلے سرکاری ٹھیکے دینے کے الزامات کی سختردیدی کی ہے۔ ان کا کہنا ہے کہ انھوں نے کبھی اس قسم کا کوئی کام نہیں کیا اور یہ سارا معاملہ ان کے سیاسی مخالفین کی طرف سے تیار کردہ ایک سازش ہے۔ پیٹرو کے وکلا نے اس سلسلے میں متعلقہ حکام کے پاس شکایات بھی درج کروائی ہیں تاکہ اس تمام پروپیگنڈے اور الزامات کا قانونی دفاع کیا جا سکے۔

خاتون کی طرف سے اس مبینہ تعلق کے ثبوت کے طور پر کچھ ویڈیوز بھی سامنے آئی ہیں جن میں دونوں کو ایک ساتھ دیکھا جا سکتا ہے۔ تاہم ان ویڈیوز اور دعوؤں کی آزادانہ تصدیق نہیں ہو سکی۔ اس تنازعے نے ملک بھر میں ایک نئی بحث چھوٹی ہے جہاں ایک طرف الزامات لگائے جا رہے ہیں تو دوسری طرف سابق صدر اس سب کو سیاسی انتقام اور جھوٹ قرار دے رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: Federal Minister Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh Calls For New Provinces and Public Referendum
stories.summary:
Federal Minister Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh has stated that the country must establish new provinces, suggesting that a referendum could be organized to gauge public sentiment on the matter. Speaking to the media in Chiniot, Sheikh noted that while governments and political parties generally oppose creating new regions, ordinary citizens strongly desire them. 

Highlighting demographic figures, Sheikh pointed out that Punjab ranks as the 13th largest country globally by population and argued that every district ought to receive fair, equal resources. He criticized the current administrative setup wherein all provincial resources remain concentrated under a single chief minister, questioning how such an individual could realistically support decentralization or the creation of additional provinces. 

Furthermore, the federal minister addressed internal party dynamics, asserting that true democracy is absent within political organizations because ultimate authority rests with only one or two people. He maintained that Pakistan's existing governance structure fails to serve the public interest and exclusively benefits those currently in power. Despite every political party having been given a chance to govern, Sheikh argued that the established system has continuously failed to deliver results for ordinary citizens.

In an unrelated technological note, OpenAI recently rolled out updates enabling AI agents to handle online transactions independently. Through the ChatGPT Wallet feature developed alongside American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, always-on AI agents can now book hotels and purchase products directly.

stories.title: میئر کراچی مرتضیٰ وہاب کا مصطفیٰ کمال کے بیان پر سخت ردعمل
stories.summary:
میئر کراچی مرتضیٰ وہاب نے ایم کیو ایم کے رہنما مصطفیٰ کمال کے بیان پر کڑے الفاظ میں ردعمل کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے اپنے بیان میں واضح کیا کہ مصطفیٰ کمال کوئی ایسے رہنما نہیں ہیں کہ ان کے دفاع میں پوری جماعت کھڑی ہو جائے۔ مرتضیٰ وہاب کا کہنا تھا کہ وہ لوگ جو عمرے پر جانے والے شہریوں سے بھی ویکسین کے پیسے وصول کرتے تھے، آج ان کی کارکردگی پر تنقید کرنے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں لیکن ان کی کارکردگی سے کوئی خوفزدہ نہیں۔

مرتضیٰ وہاب نے مزید کہا کہ جو لوگ وزیراعلیٰ سندھ سے استعفے کا مطالبہ کر رہے ہیں وہ جمہوری میدان میں الیکشن کے ذریعے عوام کے سامنے آئیں۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ موجودہ سیاسی ماحول میں مخالفین عوام کا سامنا کرنے کی سکت نہیں رکھتے اور محض الزامات کی سیاست پر یقین رکھتے ہیں۔

دوسری جانب سندھ حکومت کی ترجمان سمتہ افضال نے بھی مصطفیٰ کمال کو تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے کہا کہ فارم 47 کے ذریعے سامنے آنے والے افراد آج حکمرانوں کو مینڈیٹ کا طعنہ دے رہے ہیں جو کہ انتہائی حیران کن بات ہے۔ اس سیاسی لفظ جنگ نے صوبے کی سیاست میں ایک بار پھر ہلچل پیدا کر دی ہے۔

یہ بیانات ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئے ہیں جب ملک بھر میں مختلف سیاسی جماعتوں کے درمیان کشیدگی عروج پر ہے۔ ایک طرف جہاں پیپلز پارٹی کے رہنما سندھ میں اپنی کارکردگی کا دفاع کر رہے ہیں، وہیں دوسری طرف مخالف جماعتیں حکومت پر کڑی تنقید کے ذریعے اپنے سیاسی اثر و رسوخ کو بحال کرنے کی کوششوں میں مصروف ہیں۔

stories.title: شہید میجر عمر ناصر منہاس کو آبائی علاقے چتال میں سپرد خاک
stories.summary:
چتال سے تعلق رکھنے والے پاک فوج کے شہید میجر عمر ناصر منہاس کو ان کے آبائی علاقے میں پورے فوجی اعزاز کے ساتھ سپرد خاک کر دیا گیا۔ میجر عمر ناصر منہاس نے 14 نومبر کو بلوچستان کے ضلع نوشکی کے علاقے کردیگاپ میں سیکیورٹی قافلے کی حفاظت کے فرائض انجام دیتے ہوئے جامِ شہادت نوش کیا تھا۔ ان کے ہمراہ حوالدار محمد عدنان خان نے بھی اپنی جان کا نذرانہ پیش کیا۔

شہید میجر کی نمازِ جنازہ کور کمانڈر منگلا شاکر اللّٰہ خٹک نے خود پڑھائی۔ اس موقع پر عسکری، سیاسی اور سماجی شخصیات کی بڑی تعداد نے شرکت کی جبکہ ڈسٹرکٹ پولیس آفیسر چکوال محمد عاصم جسرا کی زیرِ نگرانی سخت سیکیورٹی کے انتظامات کیے گئے تھے۔ جب شہید کا جسدِ خاکی ان کے آبائی گاؤں پہنچا تو فضا پاکستان زندہ باد کے نعروں سے گونج اٹھی۔

33 سالہ میجر عمر ناصر منہاس کا تعلق ایک انتہائی غازی اور فوجی خاندان سے ہے۔ ان کے والد کرنل ناصر منہاس پاک فوج کی خدمت کر چکے ہیں جبکہ ان کے دو بھائی میجر حسن ناصر منہاس اور میجر علی ناصر منہاس بھی پاک فوج میں اپنے فرائض سرانجام دے رہے ہیں۔ اس خاندان کی پاک فوج کے لیے قربانیاں ملک و قوم کے دفاع میں ان کے عزم کی مظہر ہیں۔

اسپوت فوجیوں کی یہ قربانیاں ملک میں امن کے قیام اور دہشت گردی کے خلاف جنگ کی قیمت کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں۔ عوام اور عسکری قیادت نے شہید کے درجات کی بلندی کے لیے دعا کی اور ملک کے دفاع کے لیے جانیں نچھاور کرنے والے بہادر سپوتوں کو زبردست خراجِ تحسین پیش کیا۔

stories.title: Huawei Previews Foldable Mate X8 Design Without Details on Launch or Specs
stories.summary:
Huawei has unveiled the initial official imagery of its upcoming Mate X8 foldable smartphone, showcasing the hardware from multiple angles in both folded and unfolded states. The preview was shared via a promotional video celebrating the eighth anniversary of the Mate X product lineup. However, the manufacturer withheld any specifics regarding technical specifications, pricing figures, or an official release date.

The promotional footage confirms that the Mate X8 retains the inward-folding mechanism of its predecessors, meaning the primary display remains protected inside when closed. Its rear panel features a large circular camera module that matches the design language of other Mate-series devices, bearing a strong visual resemblance to the existing Mate X7 model. Although official figures are absent, unofficial leaks suggest the device may feature a 6.5-inch external screen and an 8.15-inch internal display protected by an ultra-thin glass cover, representing a slight size increase over the previous generation.

Rumors also indicate the phone could run on Huawei’s Kirin 9050 Pro processor utilizing LogicFolding 3D architecture, offering improved performance over the Kirin 9030 Pro found in the Mate X7. Speculated configurations include a standard version with 12 GB of RAM alongside 256 GB or 512 GB of storage, and a Collector’s Edition offering 16 GB of RAM with 512 GB or 1 TB of storage. Potential color finishes reportedly include Danxia Orange, Qingshan Brocade, Xueyu White, Cangqiong Black, and Zijin.

In separate developments, OpenAI announced that its AI agents can now execute autonomous payments online. Partnering with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the newly integrated ChatGPT Wallet allows cloud-connected agents to book accommodations and purchase items automatically.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Imposes Section 144 Banning Public Gatherings Across Three Districts
stories.summary:
District administrations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa have implemented Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for a duration of one month, prohibiting public gatherings and various other activities in response to ongoing security challenges. The restrictions were enacted across the districts of Bajaur, Lakki Marwat, and Swabi.

In Bajaur, Deputy Commissioner Adnan Farid Afridi approved a 30-day ban beginning November 15 that outlaws political assemblies, state-targeted hate speech, and the public display of weapons. Security forces have been directed to heighten vigilance at entry and exit points. Meanwhile, Swabi Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Khan enforced a ban on public rallies, processions, and demonstrations to mitigate serious security risks to human life and property, requiring prior authorization from the administration for any such events. In Lakki Marwat, Deputy Commissioner Shahid Rafique instituted similar prohibitions alongside bans on weapon possession, pillion riding, and the setup of temporary roadside structures that could impede traffic flow.

These preventive orders arrive amid persistent militant violence across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. Recent security updates from the military's media affairs wing reported that numerous terrorists have been neutralized through intelligence-based operations in both provinces, though security personnel have also suffered casualties during the ongoing counterterrorism efforts.

Separately, OpenAI has introduced payment capabilities for its AI agents. The ChatGPT Wallet feature enables cloud-based agents to independently conduct online purchases and hotel bookings through partnerships with major financial networks such as American Express, Mastercard, and Visa.

stories.title: Taliban Authorities Ban All Cricket Broadcasting and Coverage on Kandahar Radio Stations
stories.summary:
Taliban authorities in southern Kandahar have officially prohibited local radio stations from broadcasting any content related to cricket, a sport experiencing rapid growth across Afghanistan. Although the central government has previously displayed support for the game by hosting matches during anniversary celebrations, the provincial Information and Culture Department issued a strict directive to broadcasters stating that cricket coverage is no longer permitted.

According to anonymous sources and local media managers, the ban encompasses all forms of cricket-related reporting, including match commentary, news updates, and announcements regarding tournament victories. Broadcasters confirmed receiving phone calls from the department on Saturday outlining the new restrictions. The Afghanistan Cricket Board did not immediately respond to requests for comment regarding the directive enacted in Kandahar, which serves as the home base for the supreme Taliban leader.

While the Taliban administration has outlawed mixed martial arts, it has permitted men and boys to continue playing cricket. However, severe restrictions continue to target women and girls, who remain banned from participating in sports or accessing public gyms as part of broader rules curtailing their presence in public life. The ban in Kandahar comes while the Afghan men's national cricket team is actively competing in a Test match against Zimbabwe in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.

stories.title: Ishaq Dar Welcomes Egyptian Invitation for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to Visit Cairo
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar has responded favorably to an invitation extended by his Egyptian counterpart for Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to visit Cairo. The Foreign Office announced that the positive response was conveyed during a telephone conversation between Dar and Egypt's Foreign Minister, Dr. Badr Abdelatty.

During their diplomatic exchange, the two foreign ministers reviewed various regional and international developments of mutual concern. The conversation also touched upon preparations for upcoming European diplomatic meetings, specifically highlighting the R4 and R4+E4 sessions. Both leaders stressed the importance of enhancing bilateral coordination regarding regional issues to advance broader objectives of peace and stability.

In concluding their dialogue, Dar and Dr. Abdelatty agreed to maintain close communication and continue ongoing consultations on matters affecting both nations. The proposed visit by Prime Minister Sharif aims to further solidify diplomatic ties and cooperation between Pakistan and Egypt.

stories.title: Former Bowler Chadd Sayers Claims Entire Australian Team Knew About Sandpaper Scandal
stories.summary:
Former Australia test bowler Chadd Sayers has supported recent statements made by Usman Khawaja regarding the 2018 Sandpapergate controversy. Sayers stated his belief that every member of the Australian squad during the tour of South Africa was aware that sandpaper was being utilized to alter the condition of the ball. The original cheating scandal, uncovered during the third test at Newlands in Cape Town, resulted in 12-month bans for then-captain Steve Smith and vice-captain David Warner, alongside a nine-month suspension for Cameron Bancroft.

The renewed controversy follows allegations in Khawaja's newly released autobiography, "Sabr: Finding my way in Cricket and Life," which asserts that knowledge of the ball-tampering plan extended well beyond the three penalized players. Although Cricket Australia has declined to reopen its historical investigation, David Warner has criticized the sports organization, accusing them of orchestrating a cover-up by ignoring key witnesses and unfairly narrowing the blame.

Speaking on SEN radio, Sayers recounted that he was personally handed the sandpaper to remove from the field during the second test at Port Elizabeth, noting that he was simply delivering drinks at the time. Sayers, who made his sole test appearance during the fourth test of that tour, mentioned he was never interviewed by Cricket Australia during their inquiry, speculating it might have been due to his role as the 12th man or because he possessed too much inside information.

Reactions from other team members have varied, with fast bowler Mitchell Starc denying any prior awareness of the incident and current captain Pat Cummins dismissing the claims as utter nonsense. However, Sayers maintained that reverse swing requires total team cooperation, leaving him fully convinced that all players, including the bowlers, knew what was happening on the field. He also expressed disapproval of Cummins' personal remarks directed at Khawaja during the public dispute.

stories.title: Voting Ends at Three Polling Stations in Diamer Seat Repolling
stories.summary:
Voting at three designated polling stations for Gilgit-Baltistan’s GBA-16 Diamer-II constituency concluded after a contest between the Pakistan Peoples Party candidate Attaullah Shah and the Istehkam-i-Pakistan Party candidate Imam Malik. The voting process ran from 8 am until 5 pm, accommodating 2,780 eligible registered voters who were inside the premises before closing time. Polling officer Dr Maria reported that IPP candidate Imam Malik allegedly slapped a female polling officer at the Sarai station, alongside minor disruptions, though the overall environment remained orderly.

The seat's legal battle began after the June elections, where Malik initially ran as an independent before joining the IPP and being named the returned candidate. His membership was later suspended in September by an election tribunal following a petition by Shah, which argued that postal ballots had not been counted by the returning officer. After the tribunal directed verification and counting of postal ballots, Shah emerged victorious with 6,618 votes, edging out Malik by a margin of 13 votes. This outcome was subsequently upheld by the GB Supreme Appellate Court.

Malik later challenged the results specifically at three polling stations, leading the election tribunal to accept his petition and order fresh voting within 12 days of November 6. This repolling marks the latest development in the contested electoral race for the Gilgit-Baltistan assembly seat.

stories.title: Three Commercial Ships Struck by Drones in Black Sea Near Romania
stories.summary:
Three commercial vessels sustained drone strikes in the Black Sea close to Romania’s Sulina canal late on Saturday, according to Prime Minister Luca Niculescu. In response to the incident, Romanian authorities scrambled fighter jets twice to monitor the situation in the area.

Defence Minister Stefan Radu Oprea confirmed that there were no casualties resulting from the attacks. He stated that the respective ship crews successfully brought the onboard fires under control.

The targeted vessels were identified as the Greek-flagged oil and chemical tanker Evia Petrol V, alongside two ships registered under the flag of Saint Kitts and Nevis: the bulk carrier Marsol and the oil products tanker Ali Najafov.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Imposes Month-Long Ban on Public Gatherings in Three Districts
stories.summary:
The district administrations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Bajaur, Lakki Marwat, and Swabi districts enacted Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for a duration of one month. The restrictions prohibit public assemblies, rallies, processions, and various other activities in response to ongoing security concerns and the local law and order environment.

In Bajaur, Deputy Commissioner Adnan Farid Afridi's notification banned political gatherings, state-targeted hate speech, and the public display of weapons for 30 days starting November 15. The order requires law enforcement to heighten vigilance at entry and exit points. Similarly, Swabi Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Khan banned public rallies, marches, and demonstrations without prior official permission to avert security threats and protect public property. In Lakki Marwat, Deputy Commissioner Shahid Rafique instituted a month-long prohibition on gatherings, processions, the carrying of weapons, pillion riding, and setting up temporary structures or tents on roadways that could impede traffic.

These preventive measures follow a series of recent security challenges across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Earlier, the military reported significant casualties among terrorist elements through intelligence-based operations conducted across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

stories.title: Foreign Delegates Arrive in Islamabad for 30th ECO Ministerial Meeting
stories.summary:
High-level delegates from friendly and regional nations began arriving in Islamabad on Sunday to participate in the 30th Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Ministers meeting. The two-day conference, scheduled for November 15 to 16, aims to enhance regional connectivity and integration under the leadership of Pakistan, which holds the ECO chair for 2026-2027 with the theme "Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO."

Among the arrivals welcomed at the airport by foreign ministry officials were Turkish Deputy Foreign Minister Musa Kulaklikaya, Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Deputy Secretary General Ahmad Saidmurodzoda, Organisation of Islamic Cooperation Secretary General Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed, Azerbaijani Deputy Foreign Minister Elnur Mammadov, and Kazakh Deputy Foreign Minister Arman Issagaliyev. Additionally, Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus Foreign Minister Tahsin Ertuğruloğlu reached the federal capital a day prior.

The ministerial huddle will be chaired by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar and attended by foreign ministers, delegation heads, and ECO secretariat representatives. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is also expected to attend amid ongoing Middle East conflict mediation efforts involving Pakistan and Qatar.

The main ministerial gathering follows a Meeting of Senior Officials. This preparatory session reviewed organizational programs, evaluated subsidiary bodies, and finalized the agenda and draft outcome documents for consideration by the council members.

stories.title: Kagiso Rabada Claims Three Early Wickets as Bangladesh Fights Back
stories.summary:
South African fast bowler Kagiso Rabada delivered a destructive opening spell on Sunday at the DP World Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, claiming three early wickets against Bangladesh on day one of the first Test match. Winning the toss and opting to bat first, the visiting team found themselves in early trouble at 22-3. Rabada made an immediate impact by having debutant Mahfizul Islam caught on the very first ball of the match by Marco Jansen at gully following a thick edge off a rising delivery, marking the fourth time South Africa has taken a wicket with a Test match's opening ball. 

Rabada continued his onslaught by dismissing Mominul Haque for a duck, with wicketkeeper Ryan Rickelton taking the catch, before bowling captain Najmul Hossain Shanto for 12 runs in the ninth over. Despite this disastrous start, Bangladesh managed to stabilize their innings by reaching 91-3 by lunch. Tanzid Hasan provided crucial resistance, recording an unbeaten 51 runs off 82 balls. 

Alongside Hasan, Towhid Hridoy was not out on 23 runs at the lunch break. The pair successfully negotiated the remainder of the morning session through an unbroken 69-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Rabada, who previously issued a warning that South Africa would not ease up against their opponents, spearheaded the initial pressure before the tourists mounted their recovery.

This opening morning confrontation sets a competitive tone for the remainder of the test match in Johannesburg. While South Africa capitalized early on seam movement and disciplined bowling, Bangladesh's middle order demonstrated resilience to bring some stability back to their batting lineup before the midday interval.

stories.title: Islamabad Set for New Special Administrative Status and Boundaries
stories.summary:
Preparations have been finalized to transform Pakistan's capital city of Islamabad into a special administrative unit under a newly proposed model, according to government sources. The initiative aims to shape the capital into an ideal administrative entity, with a mayor designated to serve as the administrative head of the restructured territory.

Under the proposed administrative plan, the number of elected representatives for the city is slated to be between 25 and 30. Furthermore, the geographical boundaries of the capital are scheduled to expand significantly. Officials have indicated that proposals to incorporate specific sections of Rawalpindi and Haripur into the Islamabad federal territory are currently under active consideration.

The forthcoming local government elections for Islamabad are planned to be conducted utilizing this newly established system. Meanwhile, earlier proposals suggesting the inclusion of Gwadar or alternative ports within Islamabad's administrative framework have officially been relinquished by authorities, keeping the focus strictly on the capital region and its surrounding areas.

stories.title: آئین میں صوبوں سے متعلق ریفرنڈم کی گنجائش موجود ہے: کھئیل داس
stories.summary:
وزیر مملکت برائے مذہبی امور کھئیل داس کوہستانی نے مٹھی میں ایک پریس کانفرنس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ آئینِ پاکستان کے اندر صوبوں سے متعلق ریفرنڈم کرائے جانے کی مکمل گنجائش موجود ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ ملک کے موجودہ حالات اور انتظامی امور کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے آئینی دائرہ کار میں رہتے ہوئے تمام ممکنہ اقدامات کیے جا سکتے ہیں۔

پریس کانفرنس کے دوران گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کھئیل داس کوہستانی نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ نچلی سطح تک ترقیاتی فنڈز کی بروقت فراہمی اور بلدیاتی اداروں کا مضبوط ہونا وقت کی اہم ترین ضرورت ہے۔ انہوں نے گورننس کے نظام کو مزید بہتر بنانے کی ضرورت پر بھی روشنی ڈالی تاکہ عام آدمی کے مسائل ان کی دہلیز پر حل ہو سکیں۔

وزیر مملکت نے تھر میں جاری خشک سالی کے معاملے پر بھی بات کی اور بتایا کہ انہوں نے وزیراعظم سے تھر کے لیے خصوصی امداد اور مالی فنڈز کی درخواست کی ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ پینے کے صاف پانی کی قلت اس وقت تھر کا سب سے بڑا اور سنگین مسئلہ ہے جس کے فوری حل کے لیے ہنگامی بنیادوں پر اقدامات کرنے کی ضرورت ہے۔

حکومت کی جانب سے تھر کے عوام کو ریلیف فراہم کرنے اور فنڈز کی فراہمی کے حوالے سے یہ بیانات ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئے ہیں جب مقامی سطح پر ترقیاتی کاموں اور بنیادی سہولیات کی فراہمی کو یقینی بنانا حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے۔

stories.title: Arshdeep Singh Inspires India to Victory and ODI Series Win
stories.summary:
India secured a thrilling 22-run victory against New Zealand in Tauranga on Sunday, clinching the five-match one-day international series 3-1. Sent in to bat first after a cautious start, India struggled against New Zealand's bowling attack as Matthew Fisher dismissed veterans Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli early. Axar Patel and Ishan Kishan helped rebuild the innings, with both scoring 46 runs apiece, while Shreyas Iyer and Naman Dhir added 22 runs each before India was bowled out for 209 in 42.1 overs. New Zealand bowlers Mitchell Santner and Jacob Duffy claimed three wickets each, and Fisher picked up two.

Defending the modest total, India faced a difficult challenge as New Zealand openers Will Young and Nick Kelly comfortably advanced the chase to 64-1. However, a dramatic middle-order collapse occurred as the hosts lost five wickets for just 55 runs. Player of the Match Arshdeep Singh led the pace-led fightback alongside Mohammed Siraj and Yash Thakur, who picked up his maiden ODI wicket by removing top-scorer Dean Foxcroft for 31 runs. Captain Santner offered resistance with 24 runs, but the Indian bowling attack dismantled the tail, bowling New Zealand out for 187 in 48.1 overs.

Arshdeep finished with impressive figures of 3-30, while Siraj and Patel each claimed two wickets. Indian captain Shreyas Iyer praised his seamers for executing their plans effectively despite tough batting conditions throughout the series. New Zealand captain Santner acknowledged India's exceptional bowling performance and noted that longer partnerships could have changed the match outcome. The two teams are scheduled to face each other next in a two-test series starting on November 19.

stories.title: Jordan Sentences Three Men to Death Over Karak Church Attack
stories.summary:
Jordan's State Security Court handed down death sentences on Sunday to three men convicted of involvement in a deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church located in the southern governorate of Karak. The assault occurred on October 23 during a funeral in the village of Hamoud, resulting in nine fatalities and leaving 34 individuals wounded. The accused were found guilty of multiple offenses, including executing terrorist acts resulting in death, possessing weapons and ammunition for terrorist purposes, and promoting terrorist group ideologies. According to state news agency Petra, the ruling remains subject to appeal and an automatic review by the Court of Cassation.

Security forces successfully apprehended the three suspects on October 26 following a shootout at an abandoned house situated in Karak. The Public Security Directorate reported that all three men sustained wounds during the arrest, while no security personnel were injured. The violent incident against Jordan's Christian minority prompted swift military action on the same day, with Jordan launching retaliatory airstrikes in southern Syria targeting factions linked to the church assault.

Initial Syrian reports indicated that the airstrikes resulted in the deaths of seven individuals, including a woman and three children. Jordan subsequently acknowledged that its military operation had inadvertently killed civilians in neighboring Syria. In response to the civilian casualties, Jordanian and Syrian authorities agreed to establish a joint security committee to review the incident and address its wider consequences.

stories.title: Trump Judicial Appointment Blitz Encounters Resistance From Senate Republicans
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump's final efforts to install conservative judges to lifetime seats on district and appeals courts before Democrats take control of the Senate are facing pushback from fellow Republicans. Although Senate Republicans previously confirmed 57 nominees during Trump's second term, a handful of lawmakers are now blocking or questioning specific choices. Senators traditionally help select judges for their home states, often utilizing "blue slips" to block trial court nominees on the Senate Judiciary Committee.

Retiring Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina and Senator John Cornyn of Texas are among those using their positions to challenge nominees. The White House recently withdrew US District Judge Lee Rudofsky’s nomination to the 8th US Circuit Court of Appeals after opposition from Arkansas Senators John Boozman and Tom Cotton, replacing him with Arkansas Supreme Court Justice J. Cody Hiland. Cornyn has also declined to support T. Elliot Gaiser for a Dallas federal judgeship, while Tillis is supporting Oklahoma Senator Alan Armstrong's opposition to Zach West.

Senate Majority Leader John Thune stated that judicial confirmations remain a top priority while Republicans retain control of the chamber. Twenty-three nominees are still pending, including US District Judge Daniel Domenico for the 10th US Circuit Court of Appeals. The White House expressed confidence that all pending judicial nominees will be confirmed this year, continuing an initiative from Trump's first term that saw 234 judicial appointments.

Legal experts note that outgoing senators are standing in the way of movement conservatives being placed on the bench. Tillis argued that the White House needs to show more respect to senators when selecting judges. With the Senate Judiciary Committee scheduled to vote on advancing candidates, the current disputes highlight tensions between the White House and lawmakers during the lame-duck session.

stories.title: Former Bowler Chadd Sayers Claims Entire Australia Team Knew of Ball Tampering
stories.summary:
Former Australia test bowler Chadd Sayers has supported Usman Khawaja's recent claims regarding the 2018 Sandpapergate scandal in South Africa. Sayers stated that he believes everyone in the Australian squad during the Newlands tour knew that sandpaper was being used to alter the condition of the ball during the third test. The original incident resulted in 12-month bans for captain Steve Smith and vice-captain David Warner, alongside a nine-month suspension for Cameron Bancroft.

In his autobiography "Sabr: Finding my way in Cricket and Life," Khawaja alleged that knowledge of the plan extended well beyond the three penalized players. Following these statements, Cricket Australia has ruled out reopening its 2018 inquiry, while Warner accused the governing body of a cover-up. Sayers, who made his sole test appearance during the fourth test of that tour, revealed he was never interviewed by Cricket Australia as part of their initial investigation.

Sayers also corroborated Khawaja's assertion that sandpaper was present during the second test at Port Elizabeth, noting that he was the player who removed it from the field after drinks were brought out. He explained that achieving reverse swing requires total team cooperation, stating that bowlers and fielders alike must buy into the process to maintain the ball's condition without interruption.

While fast bowler Mitchell Starc denied prior knowledge and captain Pat Cummins dismissed the new allegations as utter nonsense, Sayers expressed certainty that the entire team was aware. Sayers additionally criticized Cummins for making personal remarks toward Khawaja regarding the ongoing controversy.

stories.title: South Korea Investigates Top Tax Accountant Exam Scorer Over AI Cheating
stories.summary:
South Korean police have launched an investigation after the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam confessed to using artificial intelligence to cheat. The candidate, who achieved first place in both the April and July rounds with a score of 397.5 out of 400 points, admitted through his lawyer to utilizing AI to obtain answers. His near-perfect first-round score of 397.5, which included only one wrong answer across 160 questions, initially sparked cheating accusations involving smart glasses that he had previously denied.

In a video posted on his lawyer's YouTube channel, the candidate expressed deep regret for his actions. He explained that he used a miniature camera to photograph exam questions, transmitted them to an AI program, and checked the answers on his smartphone. He cited financial struggles following a career change and a desire to avoid disappointing his parents as his motivations for cheating.

The examination is administered by the Human Resources Development Service of Korea (HRDK), whose president, Lee Byung-hoon, apologized for the breach and announced plans to file a criminal complaint against the candidate for obstruction of business. Two supervisors were reportedly present during the test. The presidential office has responded by ordering a comprehensive investigation into all suspected AI cheating cases across national qualification examinations.

Authorities have increased vigilance regarding high-tech cheating methods, particularly involving smart glasses. The HRDK reported that an AI inspector recently caught a test-taker wearing smart glasses during a gas engineer certification exam. The government also announced plans to file criminal complaints against students caught using similar devices in the upcoming Suneung national university entrance exam.

stories.title: PTI Founder Not Ready to Give Blank Cheque on 28th Amendment, Says Raja
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) leader Salman Akram Raja stated that the party's founder is unwilling to provide a blank cheque regarding the proposed 28th constitutional amendment. Speaking on the ARY talk show "Sawal Yeh Hai," Raja noted that no direct negotiations have occurred between the government and PTI concerning political relief or support for the amendment.

Raja claimed that decision-makers are attempting to supply one-sided information to the imprisoned PTI founder in order to secure favorable decisions. He expressed concern that the proposed constitutional changes are intended to restrict provincial assembly authority and clip the powers of provincial legislatures.

Furthermore, Raja voiced suspicions regarding recent meetings held in jail between the party's founder and two lawyers. He suggested that these meetings were deliberately orchestrated to achieve specific political objectives rather than genuine legal consultations.

In a separate development, government sources reported that preparations have been finalized to grant the capital city of Islamabad the status of a special administrative unit. Under a proposed new administrative model aimed at making Islamabad an ideal unit, the mayor will serve as the administrative head.

stories.title: Megaspeed Confirms Alice Huang Left Singapore Firm in August 2025
stories.summary:
Singapore-based cloud-computing firm Megaspeed International announced that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang officially departed the company on August 30, 2025, holding no current role. Huang, previously identified as a top executive and the controlling shareholder since March 2023, has been linked in reports to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, drawing US national security concerns and allegations from American authorities that she is a Chinese spy.

The company, an Nvidia business partner in the Asia-Pacific region, has faced intense scrutiny. In October 2025, the New York Times reported that Megaspeed was under US investigation regarding whether it assisted Chinese customers in acquiring Nvidia computer chips restricted by Washington's export controls. While China denied these allegations, Megaspeed has not been found in violation of any rules.

Addressing recent media reports, Megaspeed stated that assertions concerning its business, supply chain, and global operations lack verifiable evidence. The firm maintained that it engages in legitimate and lawful business, noting that it hired external legal counsel to conduct a thorough internal investigation and designed its operations to comply with US export-control requirements.

The announcement matters as it sheds light on a high-profile corporate leadership change amidst geopolitical tensions over advanced technology supply chains and US-China trade restrictions. Neither the US government nor Nvidia responded immediately to requests for comment regarding Megaspeed's recent statement.

stories.title: Islamabad Drug Control Authority Warns Pharmacists Against Duplicate Licences
stories.summary:
The Pharmacy Services and Drug Control in Islamabad has issued an advisory instructing all approved pharmacists and applicants seeking a Drug Sale Licence to verify that no active licence already exists under their name anywhere in Pakistan. Issued by the PS&DC, the notice highlights that drug sale permits granted by various provincial and territorial authorities can be tracked digitally through its official platform.

To address this issue, the regulatory body has commenced a formal crackdown against violations, urging professionals to adhere to the legal framework and maintain high ethical standards to steer clear of potential legal repercussions. However, the advisory explicitly notes that individuals who voluntarily disclose any pre-existing licences will be exempt from legal action.

Through this directive, the Islamabad authority has reaffirmed its dedication to upholding professional integrity, ensuring regulatory compliance, and safeguarding public health across the country. The move comes as part of ongoing efforts to monitor and regulate pharmaceutical operations nationwide through better digital tracking mechanisms.

Authorities encourage all concerned professionals to review their licensing status immediately and cooperate with the ongoing regulatory oversight. Compliance helps maintain transparency within the healthcare sector and protects consumers from unregulated pharmaceutical sales practices.

stories.title: Iran Launches Second Drone Attack on Bahrain in Three Days, Rattling Gulf
stories.summary:
Explosions echoed across Bahrain on Sunday following an Iranian drone attack, marking the second such strike in three days and shattering a lengthy period of calm in the region. Siren alarms sounded while authorities issued safety alerts via social media for the first time since September, urging residents to seek shelter immediately.

Iran’s Revolutionary Guards stated that they targeted a US radar system situated at the Al-Riffa helicopter base on the desert island state, utilizing six drones from their Aerospace Force. Meanwhile, Bahrain’s military and foreign ministry confirmed that air defence systems successfully intercepted the incoming drones, preventing them from reaching their intended targets.

This incident follows a previous drone launch on Friday against Gulf nations, representing the first direct strikes on the energy-rich region since the broader Middle East conflict began. The Bahraini foreign ministry strongly condemned the aggression, stating that the nation refuses to serve as an arena for settling foreign scores and holds Tehran entirely responsible for the escalation.

The wider conflict has persisted for over eight months following initial US-Israeli strikes, with ongoing disruptions to maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz and repeated attacks on regional infrastructure. US Central Command reported no casualties or damage in previous engagements, while international leaders continue diplomatic efforts to address the ongoing crisis.

stories.title: کوہاٹ میں غیر قانونی سونا نکالنے کے دوران مٹی کا تودہ گرنے سے 3 مزدور جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کوہاٹ کے علاقے گمبٹ میں دربوکیچ کے مقام پر دریائے سندھ سے مبینہ طور پر غیر قانونی طور پر سونا نکالنے کے دوران ایک افسوسناک حادثہ پیش آیا۔ کام کے دوران اچانک مٹی کا تودہ گر گیا جس کے نتیجے میں تین مزدور ملبے تلے دب گئے۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی ریسکیو حکام نے فوری طور پر امدادی کارروائیوں کا آغاز کیا۔ ٹیموں نے ملبے سے ایک نوجوان کو شدید زخمی حالت میں نکال کر فوری طور پر اسپتال منتقل کیا، لیکن وہ زخموں کی تاب نہ لاتے ہوئے دم توڑ گیا جبکہ دیگر دو مزدور بھی اس حادثے میں جاں بحق ہو چکے ہیں۔

حکام کی جانب سے فراہم کردہ معلومات کے مطابق اس حادثے میں اپنی جان کی بازی ہارنے والے تینوں نوجوانوں کا تعلق ترابیرہ کے علاقے سے تھا۔ اس المناک واقعے کے بعد علاقے میں غم کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے اور انتظامیہ کی جانب سے مزید صورتحال کا جائزہ لیا جا رہا ہے۔

اس نوعیت کے غیر قانونی اقدامات اور کان کنی کے حوالے سے ماضی میں بھی مختلف حلقوں کی جانب سے تشویش کا اظہار کیا جاتا رہا ہے۔ اس حادثے نے دریائے سندھ کے کنارے ہونے والی غیر قانونی سرگرمیوں کے خطرناک نتائج کو ایک بار پھر واضح کر دیا ہے، جس سے قیمتی انسانی جانوں کا ضیاع ہوا۔

stories.title: بالی ووڈ اداکار شرد کپور کی مالی مدد اور کام کی اپیل
stories.summary:
انڈین اداکار شرد کپور کی گزشتہ چند دنوں سے سوشل میڈیا پر گردش کرنے والی ویڈیوز میں ان کی صحت خراب دکھائی دے رہی ہے اور وہ چلنے پھرنے سے بھی قاصر نظر آ رہے ہیں۔ پچاس سالہ اداکار نے شاہ رخ خان کے ساتھ فلم ’جوش‘ اور سشمیتا سین کے ساتھ فلم ’دستک‘ سمیت متعدد بڑی بالی ووڈ فلموں میں اداکاری کی ہے، لیکن وہ گزشتہ کئی برسوں سے انڈسٹری سے دور ہیں۔

بومبے ٹائمز کو دیے گئے انٹرویو میں شرد کپور نے بتایا کہ چند ماہ قبل فٹ بال کھیلتے ہوئے ان کی ٹانگ ٹوٹ گئی تھی جس کے بعد وہ شدید پریشانی میں مبتلا ہو گئے تھے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ انہوں نے اپنی کرپٹو کرنسی فروخت کی تھی جس کے بعد ان کا بینک اکاؤنٹ فریز کر دیا گیا اور انکم ٹیکس حکام کی جانب سے پوچھ گچھ کی گئی۔ اس دوران کولکتہ میں موجود ان کے بھائی نے ان کی مالی معاونت کی۔

اداکار نے فلم انڈسٹری سے مالی، اخلاقی اور ذہنی مدد کی اپیل کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ وہ موجودہ مالی مشکلات سے نکلنا چاہتے ہیں۔ تاہم، باندرا میں واقع اپنے فلیٹ میں موجود شرد کپور کا یہ بھی کہنا تھا کہ انہیں مالی امداد سے زیادہ کام کی ضرورت ہے اور انہیں کام مانگنے میں کوئی شرم محسوس نہیں ہوتی۔

سوشل میڈیا پر شرد کپور کی حالت پر تشویش کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے متعدد صارفین اور شخصیات نے بالی ووڈ سے اپیل کی ہے کہ وہ ان کی مدد کریں اور سنیما کے لیے ان کی خدمات کے پیش نظر انہیں ایک اور موقع فراہم کیا جائے۔ شرد کپور کا کیریئر 1994 میں فلم ’میرا پیارا بھارت‘ سے شروع ہوا تھا اور وہ لکشیا اور جے ہو جیسی فلموں میں بھی نظر آ چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: Mohammad Yousuf and Sana Mir Inducted into PCB Hall of Fame
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board has inducted former national team captains Mohammad Yousuf and Sana Mir into its Hall of Fame for 2025. This latest addition expands the prestigious group of cricket legends to a total of 16 honored individuals who have made historic contributions to the sport in Pakistan.

Mohammad Yousuf earned his place through an open voting process, reflecting his status as one of the country's most prolific batsmen. Throughout his international career across 381 matches, he accumulated 17,300 runs, notably setting a world record in 2006 by scoring 1,788 Test runs within a single calendar year.

Sana Mir received automatic entry into the Hall of Fame as a result of her prior induction into the International Cricket Council Hall of Fame. Recognized as a pioneer in Pakistani women's cricket, she played 226 international matches, capturing 240 wickets and scoring 2,432 runs while successfully captaining the team to gold medals at the Asian Games in 2010 and 2014.

PCB Chairman Mohsin Naqvi praised both athletes, noting that they represented Pakistan with immense pride and that their inductions properly honor their exceptional performances and lasting impact on the game. They join a distinguished list of 14 previous inductees, including notable figures like Wasim Akram, Javed Miandad, and Imran Khan.

stories.title: Islamabad Opens First Digital Parking Plaza in Blue Area
stories.summary:
Islamabad’s inaugural modern digital parking plaza in the Blue Area has officially commenced full operations, offering round-the-clock services and accommodating more than 1,200 vehicles. The Capital Development Authority confirmed that the facility will remain accessible 24 hours a day throughout the week to help alleviate persistent issues regarding traffic congestion, haphazard parking, and a lack of designated spaces in major commercial zones.

During an initial introductory period, parking at the multi-level facility will be provided free of charge for a few days. Following this trial window, standard rates of Rs100 per car and Rs50 per motorcycle will apply, though the first 20 minutes of parking will remain entirely free for all motorists using the location.

The installation features a comprehensive digital parking management and monitoring system designed to oversee vehicle entries and exits while enhancing overall security measures. Motorists will receive digital receipts, and the facility supports cashless alongside online payment options, with fees collected upon departure from the premises.

Beyond vehicle storage, the development incorporates commercial and recreational features to serve the public. Several commercial shops within the building have completed their auctions, and a restaurant is scheduled to open on the rooftop to enhance the visitor experience.

Authorities anticipate that the integration of digital monitoring and cashless transactions will grant citizens secure, transparent parking infrastructure. This project marks a significant initial advancement in introducing modernized digital parking solutions across the federal capital.

stories.title: Criticism Follows Aggressive Celebrations After India's U-19 Asia Cup Win
stories.summary:
Widespread social media criticism has emerged following India's dramatic one-wicket victory over Pakistan in the U-19 Asia Cup final at the Al-Amerat Cricket Ground in Muscat. Footage circulating online captured Indian players engaging in aggressive celebrations, making inappropriate gestures, and directing abusive language toward their opponents after Mohit Ulva secured the winning boundary off the final delivery.

Videos highlighted players, including Manal Chauhan, making provocative gestures toward Pakistan wicket-keeper-batter Hamza Zahoor, alongside members of the Indian side rushing onto the field without immediate handshakes. A member of India's support staff was observed attempting to calm the players down amidst the tense atmosphere on the pitch.

The behaviour sparked strong reactions from former players, journalists, and public figures. Former federal minister Fawad Chaudhry criticized the conduct on X, while journalist Fahd Hussain described the actions as a disgrace. Former cricketer Ahmed Shahzad argued that celebrations should reflect the joy of winning rather than hostility, emphasizing that young athletes must be taught proper sportsmanship. Former batting maestro Mohammad Yousuf and columnist Ammar Masood also condemned the scenes as contrary to the core spirit and ethics of cricket.

In contrast, Board of Control for Cricket in India secretary Devajit Saikia defended the players' actions. He stated that such celebrations were understandable given the circumstances of recovering from 252 for eight to successfully chase down Pakistan's 338-run target, finishing at 339 for nine.

The controversy underscores ongoing tensions surrounding high-pressure encounters between the two neighbouring national teams. The match itself featured notable performances, including a century by Pakistan's Usman Khan as his team posted 337 for nine before the dramatic last-ball conclusion.

stories.title: Islamabad Welcomes Foreign Delegations for 30th ECO Ministerial Meeting
stories.summary:
Islamabad is currently hosting the two-day 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation Council of Ministers, with various international delegations arriving in the capital for the summit. The Foreign Office reported receiving Turkish Deputy Foreign Minister Musa Kulaklikaya, alongside other high-ranking officials gathering for the regional conference.

Additional dignitaries who have reached Islamabad include Azerbaijan’s Deputy Foreign Minister Elnur Mammadov, Kazakhstan’s Deputy Foreign Minister Arman Issagaliyev, Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Deputy Secretary General Ahmad Saidmurodzoda, and Organisation of Islamic Cooperation Secretary General Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed. Furthermore, Tahsin Ertugruloglu, Foreign Minister of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, arrived ahead of the schedule.

Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar is set to chair the ministerial session. Prior to the ministers' gathering, senior officials from member states convened to review the ECO's activities, assess subsidiary bodies, and finalize the agenda and draft outcome documents for formal consideration.

Pakistan holds the organizational chairmanship for the 2026-27 period, operating under the designated theme “Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO.” The Foreign Office stated that Pakistan's tenure prioritizes enhanced regional connectivity, integration, strong partnerships, and collaborative efforts toward sustainable economic development and growth.

The ECO comprises 10 member states: Pakistan, Afghanistan, Azerbaijan, Iran, Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Tajikistan, Türkiye, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan. Through this chairmanship, Islamabad seeks to position itself as a central hub for regional logistics, supply chains, and trade agendas.

stories.title: نامور سندھی ناول نگار اور افسانہ نویس مشتاق کاملاڻي انتقال کر گئے
stories.summary:
سجاول سے تعلق رکھنے والے معروف سندھی ناول نگار اور افسانہ نویس مشتاق کاملاڻي کچھ عرصہ علیل رہنے کے بعد اس دارِ فانی سے کوچ کر گئے۔ خاندانی ذرائع کے مطابق انہوں نے اپنے گھر پر آج آخری سانس لی۔

مرحوم کی تدفین آج شام سجاول کے مقامی مقام پر عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔ مشتاق کاملاڻي نے سندھی ادب کے فروغ کے لیے کئی ناول، افسانے اور دیگر ادبی تخلیقات یادگار چھوڑیں۔

ان کے انتقال کی خبر سنتے ہی ملک بھر کے علمی و ادبی حلقوں میں گہرے رنج و غم کی لہر دوڑ گئی اور مختلف شخصیات نے ان کی ادبی خدمات پر افسوس کا اظہار کیا ہے۔

stories.title: وفاقی حکومت کا اسلام آباد کو خصوصی انتظامی حیثیت دینے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
وفاقی حکومت نے وفاقی دارالحکومت اسلام آباد کو خصوصی انتظامی حیثیت دینے اور ایک نیا انتظامی ماڈل متعارف کرانے کی تمام تیاریاں مکمل کر لی ہیں۔ حکومتی ذرائع کے مطابق اس تجویز کا مقصد اسلام آباد کو ایک مثالی انتظامی یونٹ بنانا ہے، جس کا سربراہ میئر ہوگا۔ مجوزہ انتظامی یونٹ کے لیے منتخب ارکان کی تعداد 25 سے 30 رکھنے کی تجویز بھی زیر غور ہے۔

منصوبے کے تحت اسلام آباد کی جغرافیائی اور انتظامی ہیئت میں تبدیلی کے علاوہ اس کی حدود میں توسیع بھی کی جائے گی۔ اس ضمن میں خیبرپختونخوا کے ضلع ہری پور، راولپنڈی کے بعض علاقوں اور ضلع مری کے حلقہ این اے 51 کے علاقوں کو وفاقی دارالحکومت میں شامل کرنے کی تجاویز پر غور جاری ہے۔ تاہم، حکومتی ذرائع نے واضح کیا ہے کہ گوادر یا دیگر بندرگاہوں کو اسلام آباد کے انتظامی ڈھانچے کا حصہ بنانے کا منصوبہ ترک کر دیا گیا ہے۔

اس مجوزہ اقدام کا بنیادی مقصد دارالحکومت کے انتظامی امور کو بہتر بنانا اور بلدیاتی نظام کو زیادہ مؤثر بنانا ہے۔ اس تبدیلی سے اسلام آباد کے شہریوں کو بہتر سہولیات کی فراہمی اور انتظامی سطح پر فیصلہ سازی کے عمل کو مزید شفاف اور فعال بنانے میں مدد ملے گی۔ حکومتی سطح پر اس حوالے سے تیاریوں کو حتمی شکل دی جا چکی ہے تاکہ اس نئے انتظامی ماڈل کا باضابطہ نفاذ کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Mustafa Kamal Announces Vital Referendum Preparations for New Provinces in December
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Health and Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan leader Syed Mustafa Kamal announced that a referendum concerning the establishment of new provinces will take place, designating December as a crucial month for the initiative. He made the remarks while addressing party workers in District Central.

During his address, Kamal asserted that the time has arrived to dismantle feudal, wadera, and capitalist systems, noting that state priorities and public problem solutions are currently aligned. He stated that oppressed individuals across the nation look toward Karachi for the creation of new administrative units, emphasizing that Pakistan is experiencing a decisive turning point.

Kamal alleged that opponents of new provinces aim to provoke conflicts among linguistic and ethnic communities in Karachi and Sindh. He described Sindhis as oppressed people and stated that MQM-P bears the responsibility to safeguard their lives, assets, and dignity, while simultaneously urging Muhajirs to embrace all communities living in the city.

Additionally, Kamal directed criticism toward the Pakistan Peoples Party, claiming the party secures only 20 percent of total votes and fails to represent the entirety of Sindh province. He further alleged that the PPP resists conducting an accurate population count for Karachi, which he stated stands at 30.5 million residents.

stories.title: Authorities Ban Political Gatherings in Bajaur for 30 Days
stories.summary:
The district administration in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Bajaur has enacted a 30-day ban on all political assemblies, public hate speech directed at the state, and the open display of weapons. Announced on Sunday, the restrictions were ordered by Bajaur Deputy Commissioner Adnan Farid Afridi by invoking Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure due to a tense regional security climate. Officials stated the measures are necessary to protect public property, preserve human life, and maintain civil order.

Under the notification, local law enforcement units are instructed to heighten vigilance, secure entry and exit checkpoints around the district, and actively prevent unauthorized public gatherings. The directive took effect immediately on November 15 and remains active until December 15, unless authorities choose to modify or rescind it beforehand. Individuals caught defying the restrictions will face prosecution under Section 188 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

This administrative action follows a similar 10-day ban on pillion riding implemented in Bajaur last October amidst security concerns. The broader Khyber Pakhtunkhwa region has struggled with persistent militant threats and violent attacks. Last month, a local police officer was killed during a militant raid on a security post in Bajaur.

The security clampdown coincides with wider military anti-terror operations across Pakistan. On Friday, the military's media wing reported that 74 terrorists had been neutralized in ongoing intelligence-based operations across Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan over a 48-hour period, resulting in casualties among both militants and military personnel.

stories.title: شرجیل امام کی قید پر امریکی کمیشن اور انڈین سفیر آمنے سامنے
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں انڈین سفیر ونے موہن کواترا نے امریکی کمیشن برائے بین الاقوامی مذہبی آزادی (یو ایس سی آئی آر ایف) کے اس بیان کو تعصبانہ اور جانبدارانہ قرار دیا ہے جس میں چھ سال سے قید طالب علم شرجیل امام کی حراست پر تشویش ظاہر کی گئی تھی۔ یو ایس سی آئی آر ایف نے اپنی سوشل میڈیا پوسٹ اور ویب سائٹ پر دعویٰ کیا تھا کہ شرجیل امام کو مذہبی آزادی کی وکالت اور شہریت ترمیمی قانون کے خلاف مظاہروں کے دوران مبینہ تقاریر کرنے پر قید کیا گیا ہے۔

جواہر لعل نہرو یونیورسٹی کے سابق طالب علم شرجیل امام کو دہلی پولیس نے 28 جنوری 2020 کو بہار کے شہر جہان آباد سے گرفتار کیا تھا۔ ان پر سی اے اے اور این آر سی کے خلاف احتجاج کے دوران مبینہ طور پر اشتعال انگیز تقاریر کرنے، بغاوت پھیلانے اور بعد ازاں اگست 2020 کی ایک ایف آئی آر کے تحت دہشت گردی، ہنگامہ آرائی اور قتل سمیت مختلف سنگین نوعیت کے الزامات عائد کیے گئے تھے۔

امریکی سفیر ونے موہن کواترا نے اس تنقید کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس خود مختار امریکی کمیشن کو انڈین شہریوں کے آئینی حقوق کے بارے میں رائے دینے کا کوئی حق نہیں ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اس قسم کے جائزے مذہبی آزادی سے متعلق انڈیا کے آئینی عزم کو کمزور نہیں کر سکتے اور کمیشن کو دوسروں کو نصیحت کرنے کے بجائے اپنے تعصبات کا جائزہ لینا چاہیے۔

دوسری جانب یو ایس سی آئی آر ایف نے اپنی تازہ ترین رپورٹ میں انڈیا میں مذہبی آزادی کی ابتر صورتحال کا حوالہ دیتے ہوئے اسے کنٹریز آف پارٹیکولر کنسرن کی فہرست میں شامل کرنے کی سفارش کی ہے۔ کمیشن کے مطابق انڈیا میں اقلیتوں کے حقوق متاثر ہو رہے ہیں اور قوم پرست گروہوں کی جانب سے حملوں میں اضافہ ہوا ہے، تاہم انڈین حکومت پہلے ہی ایسی رپورٹس کو مسترد کر چکی ہے۔

stories.title: Former Bowler Chadd Sayers Backs Claims That Entire Team Knew About Sandpapergate
stories.summary:
Former Australian Test cricketer Chadd Sayers has publicly supported teammate Usman Khawaja's assertion that the entire Australian squad was aware of the ball-tampering plot during the 2018 tour of South Africa. Sayers, who was part of the touring party and played in the fourth Test in Johannesburg, contradicted current Test captain Pat Cummins' repeated denials regarding team-wide knowledge of the incident at Cape Town.

Following a formal inquiry in 2018, Cricket Australia concluded that only captain Steve Smith, vice-captain David Warner, and batsman Cameron Bancroft orchestrated the use of sandpaper to alter the condition of the ball. All three players faced suspension and were sent home. However, Khawaja's recent autobiography alleges that the entire team had knowledge of the tactics, a sentiment echoed by both Warner and now Sayers in statements to SEN radio.

Sayers revealed that sandpaper was also utilized during the second Test in Port Elizabeth, noting that he was the player who inadvertently carried it onto the field while delivering drinks. He added that discussions regarding reverse swing and ball-tampering methods frequently occurred openly within the team dressing rooms. Captain Pat Cummins strongly dismissed these allegations during a press conference, calling them entirely false and pointing to a 2018 joint statement by the bowling group denying awareness.

The controversy intensified as David Warner accused Cricket Australia of a cover-up, claiming that key bowlers like Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc, and Nathan Lyon were never formally interviewed during the original probe. Although media reports subsequently confirmed those interviews took place, Warner criticized the governing body for failing to provide complete evidence to the players penalized in 2018. Meanwhile, Cricket Australia has stated it has no plans to reopen an investigation into the matter.

stories.title: SpaceX Starship Completes Historic Orbital Flight and Successful Tower Catch
stories.summary:
SpaceX achieved a major engineering milestone on Saturday when its Starship spacecraft successfully returned from a 22-hour orbital mission and was captured mid-air by mechanical arms at its Texas launch facility. Measuring 171 feet tall, the Starship descended through heavy clouds over the Starbase site in south Texas, reignited its engines to perform a vertical flip, and settled gently into the tower's specialized structural arms.

The successful recovery marks the conclusion of the rocket system's longest test flight to date.
